title: v4.1.5 repair and start OpenClaw Gateway
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';function Run-OC([string[]]$OcArgs,[string]$Tag){$so=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stdout.txt');$se=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stderr.txt');Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList $OcArgs -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;return $p.ExitCode};$needsInstall=$false;$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($null -eq $task){$needsInstall=$true}else{$bad=$false;foreach($a in @($task.Actions)){if($a.Arguments -match 'gateway\.vbs'){if($a.Arguments -match '"([^"]*gateway\.vbs)"'){$vp=$matches[1]}elseif($a.Arguments -match '([^\s]+gateway\.vbs)'){$vp=$matches[1]}else{$vp=$null};if($vp -and -not(Test-Path $vp)){$bad=$true}}};if($bad){$needsInstall=$true}};if($needsInstall){try{Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}catch{};$un=Run-OC @('gateway','uninstall') 'gateway-uninstall-050v';$install=Run-OC @('gateway','install') 'gateway-install-050v';if($install -ne 0){throw ('GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED code='+$install)}};$restart=Run-OC @('gateway','restart') 'gateway-restart-050v';if($restart -ne 0){throw ('GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED code='+$restart)};$ok=$false;for($i=0;$i -lt 15;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$so=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050v.stdout.json';$se=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050v.stderr.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList @('gateway','status','--json') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;if($p.ExitCode -eq 0){try{$j=Get-Content $so -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$ok=$true;break}catch{}}};if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_NOT_HEALTHY_JSON'};Write-Output 'V415_050V_GATEWAY=PASS'
